يفتقدون (form VIII)
# يَفْتَقِدُونَ (yaftaqidūna) /jaf.ta.qi.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# يُفْتَقَدُونَ (yuftaqadūna) /juf.ta.qa.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
